$comment: The play model's rules (docs/DESIGN.md, The play model): where a reply's history starts (the latest session on the branch), the earlier sessions' summaries it reads instead, who the person is (the character they play, else their persona) and whom the AI plays. client/src/features/chat/play.ts and server/extensions/ai_chat/Play.py run these cases.

cases.name: no sessions: the whole branch is read
the current session's lines only; the earlier one by its summary

sessions.summary: The cell landed and met the raven.

cases.summary:
Session 1, in brief:
The cell landed and met the raven.

cases.name: a rewind to before session 2 reads session 1 again; session 2's start is off the branch
three sessions: both earlier summaries, in order, skipping an empty one

seat_cases.name: playing a party member: they are the persona and leave the AI's cast
the GM's seat: the person's persona stands, the whole party is the AI's
